items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I'd say, 'Judge, you use it like a scalpel the way you slice -- ' [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, wasn't he, wasn't he? And he could take a knife and fork and clean a bone --

ctx.x: He should have been a surgeon. He wouldn't use -- he wouldn't pick up a piece of chicken with his hands. He would take -- I told him -- he would take that knife and cut the chicken and I'd say, 'Judge, you use it like a scalpel the way you slice -- '
Oh, wasn't he, wasn't he? And he could take a knife and fork and clean a bone --
